reason: Brings the GUI's chat lifecycle actions to the paired terminal client: collapsed thinking with /thinking and on-demand saved reasoning; per-turn elapsed time and token usage on answer headings; edit-and-resend that rewinds only when the edit is sent; /search over saved messages (conversation or project, bookmarked only) opening the match; /bookmark; /side side chats without tools; /chat bulk with Core verification; /chat finish for a provider answer that stopped early and a linked harness retry; pinned/flag/archived markers and whole-catalog search in /chats. Selected: the new conversations unit contracts, the shell and TUI presentation suites, the client wheel allowlist (new module), two new real paired TLS LAN Core PTY journeys, the product-knowledge search and Chroma digest sync, the settings-catalog terminal discovery test, and existing real-Core cases covering send/stream, the slash menu order, settings, remembered chats and the project picker.
exclusions: No full suites. No native or Playwright changes: only the separate Python terminal client, docs and the settings catalog keywords changed, so browser viewport projects do not exercise this journey; the catalog change is covered by its Vitest file. tests/test_terminal_pty.py and the other tests/v3/test_terminal_core.py cases are not selected: 6 of them fail identically on pristine origin/main locally (scroll [52-18], wide layout, direct chats/reconnect, loading while opening, polling, queue/detach/approval with an un-awaited store.get), and the remaining PTY cases do not touch the changed code paths. Rebased on #1034; the shell suite now includes its receipt cases. A locally stale product-knowledge index (built before the rebase changed docs/CLI.md) failed once locally and passed after rebuilding the index. test_paired_full_screen_tui_shows_progress_and_saved_answer is not selected: its raw 'YOU · SENDING' expect races Core's acceptance against an 80 ms render delay and failed 1 of 6 local runs on pristine origin/main; streamed sends are covered by the new chat parity PTY journeys. No live provider calls or Core deployment.
